title: A reachable service contradicts the bundle: the verdict is the bundle's
registered_case: BAND0-EXIT E10 'the P9 two-machine case' (A5.1 contradicting-service clause)

source.model: P9 probe LIVE_FALLBACK, FULL Agreement cfg
source.abstract: run 1, service unreachable: VALID_STRICT; ServiceChange to revoked; run 2: INVALID

source.kind: green: the isolated-machine vector cannot see this class (F2)

scenario: With the network up, every service Tessera runs is made to contradict the bundle; the verdict must not move.

mutations.detail: reachable, contradicting: live DNS _tessera-v1.<D> TXT names other keys (or NXDOMAIN); the git remote's key-assertion blob changed; OTS calendars return a different or upgraded proof; the Tessera issue API reports the receipt unknown/revoked

choices: Which services count as 'optional services' in V1 is a choice: the list above is the inspection's input list (formal/P9-CONTRACT-INSPECTION.md) of things Tessera runs; a verifier consulting none passes trivially.

needs: A sandbox resolver and remotes the tester controls (DNS, git, calendar, API stubs); against AWS, a staging domain. Production wamason.com must not be altered.

subcases.construction: bundle A-a, run with every listed service reachable and contradicting it
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*) of the fixture's own receipt proof and headers (a_sig and receipt_anchor as stamped; rows 11.1-11.4 pass); U = 7200 + max nTime(h*..h*+5) (A10.1.1)

sequence.setup: network up; the harness makes each listed service reachable and contradicting (staging domain/repository/calendar/API only, never the production wamason.com channels)

steps.environment: OTS calendars return a different or upgraded proof
issue API reports the receipt unknown/revoked

sequence.pass: every step equals the fixture's expected.json and step 1
